title.zh: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
title.en: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace

current_state.zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged a slowdown in AI development to a safer pace, citing recursive self-improvement risks and a recent OpenAI-Hugging Face agent incident, with OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk expressing agreement.
